description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Holy, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Exdeath], [Might of the Void Damage Tracker] and [Might of the Void Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Exdeath
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Might of the Void (0~2), removed after using Might of the Void two times

description.name: Might of the Void Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Might of the Void level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Exdeath]

description.name: Might of the Void Level
description.text: Keeps track of Might of the Void level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Exdeath]
